description: Said his name twice, and took him out of the wind.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Passed out of his pew without sword-bearer or halberds, and looked at nobody.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Said he had reached the second of the four last things, and sent them to eat.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Named the four parts, and told him a song is not a sermon.
name: Thomas Morley

description: Answered on the second naming, and left the line to follow him home.
name: William Shakespeare
